facts.fact: KRAY在Penalty Box（禁闭箱）里干等了两周，靠上强制网课打发无聊。
facts.anchor: KRAY hung fire in his cozy Penalty Box coffin for the next two weeks

facts.fact: 「与外国人交谈」课程建议把每次谈话的完整记录存放在安全地点，保存不少于七年，以备不时之需。
facts.anchor: storing them in a secure location for a period of no less than seven years

facts.fact: KRAY把「吃好练好」课程转发给KANDINSKY当玩笑；KANDINSKY回信说「腰围是件可怕的事」。
facts.anchor: KRAY forwarded that one to KANDINSKY as a joke.

facts.fact: 一份OSS格斗手册示范二十种一拳打死男人或女人的方法，KRAY在总部书库里照着练习。
facts.anchor: showing twenty ways to kill a man — or a woman — with one punch

facts.fact: KRAY一直想弄到一把OSS短剑，却始终没能从博物馆馆长Toni Hiley那里讨到。
facts.anchor: sweet-talk one out of Toni Hiley, the Director of the Museum

facts.fact: 周五下午，特别行动处一人与一名安保警官来到KRAY的总部工位找他。
facts.anchor: They came for him at his Headquarters cubicle early on Friday afternoon

facts.fact: 局长应Wacker之请，决定终止KRAY的安全许可与机构雇佣关系，此为终局且不可复核的决定。
facts.anchor: the Director had, at Wacker’s request, made the decision to terminate his security clearances and his Agency employment

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY的纸条约定：明天正午在国家档案馆圆厅、站在《独立宣言》前见面，并提醒要早去因为总排队。
facts.anchor: Meet me at noon tomorrow at the National Archives Rotunda. I’ll be standing in front of the Declaration of Independence.
